description: Walks and hikes: the `:::parcours` block draws a `.parcours.json` as a map with numbered markers, an elevation profile and a walking mode, and assembles its GPX on demand. A feature, not an app: a route has no domain and no tile — it hangs off whichever page has a reason to mention it.

parcours.description: A walk, drawn from the `.parcours.json` that sits beside the page.
